create_hsigmoid_default: create an HSigmoid activation layer with default bias 3.0 and divisor 6.0
create_hsigmoid_custom_params: create an HSigmoid layer with custom bias divisor min_value and max_value parameters
forward_hsigmoid_tensor: forward a PyTorch tensor through the HSigmoid layer to apply hard sigmoid activation
register_hsigmoid_activation: register the HSigmoid module in the ACTIVATION_LAYERS registry for use in model configs
review_hsigmoid_clamp: review the HSigmoid forward method that clamps output between min_value and max_value
